title: IMAP mails without a text part get their text from the sanitized HTML
IMAP connect limited per target host, send failures classified correctly, watch and poll share one fetch path
A personal password mailbox only connects the caller's own account address
detail: `connect-my-mailbox` reads the email of the session user server-side and compares it case-insensitively with the submitted address before any login attempt. A different address is refused with `personal_address_not_own` (i18n `inboundMail.accounts.errors.personalAddressNotOwn`); nothing is created and the mail server is not contacted. The OAuth path needs no extra rule, its callback already binds the mailbox to the provider-authenticated account. The IMAP feature now reads the user through the user feature, which a stack must mount.
migration: Members who connected a personal mailbox with an address other than their account email must have an admin connect it as a shared mailbox instead. Stacks that mount `inbound-provider-imap` need the user feature.

title: IMAP polling works again for mailboxes given as a host name
A mail the IMAP watch quarantines keeps its sender and subject
The IMAP provider reads text, HTML and attachments
IMAP and SMTP hosts given as IP addresses connect over TLS
The IMAP cursor follows UIDs and skips known mails
Members connect a personal IMAP mailbox from "My mail accounts"
The IMAP watch quarantines an unparseable mail right away

IMAP forms trim the mailbox name and show ports without digit grouping
Mailboxes connect and send over SMTP port 587 with STARTTLS
IMAP mailboxes can be connected from a form
IMAP mailboxes send over their own SMTP server
mailparser moved to a version without known nodemailer advisories
The deprecated inboundProviderImapFeature constant is removed
detail: inboundProviderImapFeature was kept next to createInboundProviderImapFeature() for one release. Mount the feature by calling createInboundProviderImapFeature().
migration: Run bun kumiko-upgrade --apply. It replaces inboundProviderImapFeature with createInboundProviderImapFeature().

title: inbound-provider-imap declares the MAIL_ALLOWED_PRIVATE_HOSTS env schema
migration: No action needed. An app that mounts both mail-transport-smtp and inbound-provider-imap now composes one shared field.

title: The tenant-configured IMAP host must resolve to a public address
migration:
An operator relying on an internal IMAP server or a local dev/test server
(greenmail on localhost or a private IP) now gets an InboundAuthError
(account marked auth_error) unless that host is explicitly allowed. Set
the same operator env var mail-transport-smtp reads (comma-separated, no
boot-time code call needed) before starting the process:
  KUMIKO_MAIL_ALLOWED_PRIVATE_HOSTS=greenmail.internal
This is an operator env var, not a tenant config value — a tenant cannot
add their own host to this list. A DNS resolution failure for a
genuinely unreachable host now surfaces as InboundTransientError (job
retry) instead of reaching imapflow at all.

title: IMAP connect failures no longer distinguish a blocked host from a DNS failure in the thrown message
